name: mcdev-mcp
description: MCP server for Minecraft mod development - decompiled code access, symbol search, and runtime interaction via DebugBridge
long_description: An MCP server for AI-assisted Minecraft mod development. Static tools provide access to decompiled Minecraft source code: browse classes and methods, search symbols, explore package hierarchies, find subclasses/implementors, and trace callers/callees across multiple Minecraft versions. Runtime tools interact with a running Minecraft instance through the DebugBridge mod: execute Groovy inside the JVM, capture game state snapshots and screenshots, inspect open GUI screens, list and inspect nearby entities and block-entities, render item textures from inventory slots or registry IDs, highlight entities or blocks in-world for the user, review recent chat, run slash commands, and drive session control (join/leave servers, quit the client, reconnect after a relaunch). Also exposes an MCP resources surface — including a Python client guide for the DebugBridge wire protocol and a build → deploy → relaunch → rejoin dev-loop guide — for agents that want to script the bridge directly instead of going through these tools.

enable_script_logging.title: Log script executions
enable_script_logging.description: Append every mc_execute call (timestamp, code, result, error, duration) to ~/Library/Application Support/mcdev-mcp/script-logs/ (or the platform equivalent). Also enables the mc_script_logs tool for reviewing logs from inside Claude.

tools.name: mc_version
tools.description: Set or list the active Minecraft version for static analysis tools

tools.name: mc_search
tools.description: Search decompiled source for classes, methods, and fields by name

tools.name: mc_get_class
tools.description: Get the decompiled source code of a class

tools.name: mc_get_method
tools.description: Get the decompiled source of a specific method

tools.name: mc_list_classes
tools.description: List all classes in a package path

tools.name: mc_list_packages
tools.description: List all packages in the Minecraft source

tools.name: mc_find_hierarchy
tools.description: Find subclasses or interface implementors of a class

tools.name: mc_find_refs
tools.description: Find callers or callees of a method via the callgraph

tools.name: mc_connect
tools.description: Connect to a running Minecraft instance via the DebugBridge mod

tools.name: mc_execute
tools.description: Execute Groovy code inside the running Minecraft JVM

tools.name: mc_snapshot
tools.description: Get a structured snapshot of current game state

tools.name: mc_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the Minecraft client framebuffer as a JPEG file

tools.name: mc_screen_inspect
tools.description: Snapshot the current GUI screen (chest, inventory, etc.) and its structure

tools.name: mc_chat_history
tools.description: Get recent client-side chat messages

tools.name: mc_nearby_entities
tools.description: List entities (mobs, items, projectiles, players) within range of the player

tools.name: mc_entity_details
tools.description: Get full details for one entity by id

tools.name: mc_looked_at_entity
tools.description: Returns the entity id the player is currently aiming at, or null

tools.name: mc_nearby_blocks
tools.description: List nearby block-entities (signs, chests, banners, beacons, hoppers, ...)

tools.name: mc_block_details
tools.description: Get details for the block-entity at (x, y, z)

tools.name: mc_set_entity_glow
tools.description: Outline an entity with the team-colour glow so the user can spot it

tools.name: mc_set_block_glow
tools.description: Highlight a block in the world (yellow/glow outline)

tools.name: mc_clear_block_glow
tools.description: Clear all block highlights set via mc_set_block_glow

tools.name: mc_get_item_texture
tools.description: Render the item in inventory slot N as a PNG

tools.name: mc_get_item_texture_by_id
tools.description: Render the default texture for a registry id (e.g. minecraft:diamond) as a PNG

tools.name: mc_get_entity_item_texture
tools.description: Render an item carried by another entity (mainhand, offhand, armor slot) as a PNG

tools.name: mc_join_server
tools.description: Join a multiplayer server and wait until in-world (requires bridge-side session_control_enabled)

tools.name: mc_leave_server
tools.description: Leave the current world/server to the title screen (requires bridge-side session_control_enabled)

tools.name: mc_wait_until_in_world
tools.description: Poll until the player is in a world or the join visibly failed

tools.name: mc_quit_client
tools.description: Gracefully shut down the Minecraft client and wait for it to exit (requires bridge-side session_control_enabled)

tools.name: mc_wait_for_bridge
tools.description: Wait for a relaunched client's DebugBridge to answer on ports 9876-9886, then reconnect

tools.name: mc_run_command
tools.description: Execute a Minecraft slash command (opt-in dev tool, requires MCDEV_RUN_COMMAND=1 and bridge-side opt-in)

tools.name: mc_script_logs
tools.description: Review past mc_execute runs and error patterns (opt-in via the 'Log script executions' user setting)
